exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to go away, to disperse (in different directions), to spread
to break, to crash, to crush, to smash, to shatter
to burst out laughing, to start laughing
to tear apart/asunder, to tear up
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: разойти́сь — to go away, to disperse (in different directions), to spread; разби́ть — to break, to crash, to crush, to smash, to shatter; рассмея́ться — to burst out laughing, to start laughing; разорва́ть — to tear apart/asunder, to tear up.
